results.step: No account needed: nothing is loaded from Supabase until Settings; Google is the primary button
Email me a link: sends the link with the site’s redirect address
Opening the link signs in and sync starts by itself: no code, no switch
First device: everything uploads on its own, one plain row per book; no recovery code anywhere
results.detail: 2 rows; the old encrypted row for the book was overwritten

results.step: Second device: Continue with Google, same account, and everything is just there
The book and its notes arrive on the second device: “On your other device” with an Add file action
After adding the same book, it opens at the first device’s reading place
A book from Discover has its source synced: the other device downloads it by itself
results.detail: downloaded from Project Gutenberg on the second device

results.step: An edit on the second device reaches the first
Changes sync automatically a few seconds after you make them
Reload keeps you signed in and sync on
Sign out: email gone, notes stay on the device; no Supabase calls on next launch
Delete account and synced data: rows removed, delete-account called, signed out, books stay
Empty configuration: no sign-in UI, no requests, everything else works
Supabase or its CDN unreachable: sign-in is disabled with a note; no errors
